title: Bridgeland-Enriques general K3 surfaces
summary: This article introduces a notion of Bridgeland-Enriques general K3 surfaces motivated by the study of Enriques categories over K3 surfaces and the invariant Bridgeland stability conditions. The family of Bridgeland-Enriques general K3 surfaces of degree 10 detects a categorical degeneration of special Gushel-Mukai threefolds. Also, the families of Bridgeland-Enriques general K3 surfaces with higher degrees are closely related to Hodge-special Gushel-Mukai fourfolds and double EPW sextics.
